title: Use a mock function
summary: jest.fn makes a function that records calls. A mock can stand in for a small dependency.
introduction: jest.fn makes a function that records calls. A mock can stand in for a small dependency. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: jest.fn makes a function that records calls. A mock can stand in for a small dependency.

blocks.code:
import { test, expect, jest, beforeEach } from "@jest/globals";
test("saves a score", () => { const save = jest.fn(); save(8); expect(save).toHaveBeenCalledWith(8); });
blocks.title: Use a mock function

blocks.text: The test passes because save was called with 8. No real storage is needed.

items: Read the example from top to bottom. Point to the part that uses the new idea.
Explain what changed in your own words. Check the example again if you get stuck.

blocks.title: A common mistake
blocks.text: A mock records calls; it does not prove a real database connection works.
For more detail later, use this [Jest further reading](https://jestjs.io/docs/getting-started).
